decisions.reason: Organizing funnel reporting by Contact Source does not change whether email and LinkedIn communication histories are visible in HubSpot.
The report uses existing lead stages and categories but does not modify the lead-management capabilities or their configuration.
Contact-source funnel reporting does not change synchronization of MeetAlfred reply statuses into HubSpot.
The reporting specification remains within the existing HubSpot CRM use and does not change the selected platform, subscription plan, or general intended use.
Viewing funnel stages and conversion by Contact Source does not alter how HubSpot lists are transferred to MeetAlfred.
The reporting organization does not change the selection or export of Sales Navigator prospects to Apollo.
The source decision concerns downstream CRM reporting and does not change creation or configuration of the Sales Navigator source list.
Contact Source may describe imported contacts, but the reporting requirement does not change Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer behavior or latency.
Grouping reports by Contact Source does not affect which form of LinkedIn profile URL is stored.
The funnel-report specification neither resolves the deferred integration-plan conflict nor changes the direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration requirement.
The reporting change does not alter the integration-minimization policy or the manual and automatic steps in the lead-transfer chain.
The contact-source funnel report does not change the enrichment provider, enrichment fields, or automatic enrichment mode.
